desc:
⚡ Every shot you dodge = +1 Dodge! ⚡
Train your reflexes, punch through a neon city and evolve into a cyborg!

🥊 DODGE & FIGHT
• Dodge shots on training pads to grow your Dodge
• More Dodge = harder punches + more auto-dodges
• Punch gunners through 10 levels of the neon city

🤖 BOSSES
• Beat the Drone Swarm and the giant Riot Mech
• Dodge, wait for the vent, punch the core!

🧬 EVOLVE
• 8 evolutions, from Gorilla Arms to Full Conversion
• Abilities: Shock Pulse, Mantis Dash, Holo Decoy, Overclock, Piston Punch

💚 SANDEVISTANS
• Collect 10 glowing spine implants
• Rebirth for a permanent Dodge boost

🎁 Daily rewards • Fast level-ups • Bank Wins at the gold CLAIM pad or risk them for more!

🎮 PC: Click/F punch (hold to charge), E ability, Shift dash, C slide, Q overdrive. Mobile: on-screen buttons.

👍 Like and favorite for new worlds!
